strings.import_help: Choose a library ZIP package exported from Kuwala. Review its contents before importing it into this catalogue.
strings.export_help: Download one library with its sections, original PDFs, document details, attribution and licence records.
strings.private_help: Transfers do not publish documents, approve technical advice or build search indexes.
strings.limit_help: Up to 80 MiB per package. Library packages contain PDFs and catalogue metadata; search indexes and modules are separate.
strings.size_error: This package exceeds the current 80 MiB upload limit.
strings.name_help: Choose a name for this library in the main catalogue.
strings.name_exists: A library already uses this name. Choose another name.
strings.additive_help: This adds a new library and document records to the current catalogue. Existing libraries, originals and records are retained.
strings.inspect_failed: The package could not be checked. Choose a valid Kuwala library package and try again.
strings.import_failed: The library could not be imported. Your package and chosen name are still here.
strings.export_failed: The library download could not be prepared. Please try again.
strings.imported: Imported {name} into the main catalogue. Search indexing and publication are separate steps.
strings.target_changed: The catalogue changed. Review this package again before importing it.
strings.filename_help: Imported originals receive unique filenames. Their source filenames are retained in document metadata.
